strings.en: 1. Reach the Omoikane tree.
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
This is inside a computer?
It's like a giant library...
Whoa... my school library's got nothing on this.
This is... M.I.T.'s...?
Em Eye Tee?
Exactlyyy!
Just what I'd expect from the Combattler team's boy genius.
Ah, memories! The MIT library... I failed to get in seven times!
This is just my visualization of the computer's memory core!
As an image of a memory area, it's quite fitting.
Good taste. ...Still, it's huge. This'll be tough.
Well, of course. It's the Nadesico's central computer.
Must have cost a pretty penny, don't you think?
Which way are we supposed to go?
Don't tell me we all came in here
just to find one single thing in all this?
Anyway, Uribatake, we can see it, but how do we actually work in here?
No need to worry! Now, time to sortie!
Huh!?
Is this... Alt?
An Aestivalis...!? Whoa, it's virtual, but just like the real thing!
I see! You based them on each unit's data. Only a mechanic could do that.
Figured this might come up, so I ripped every unit's data
and ran all sorts of tests. Man, the super robots were a real pain...
I see, so we're supposed to work with these.
Correct. Robots that sortie enter Omoikane's program,
where they can find and fix the bad spots. They're cyberspace's...
...well, cleanup hitmen.
Impressive. Except for the part where ripping that data is a crime.
Ugh... W-Well, let's get to work!
Which way are we supposed to go?
I'll guide you.
Okay, I'm counting on you.
Our target is Omoikane's self-awareness...
That part. ...But tampering with its self-awareness means...
Somehow, I don't like this...
You're kind, Tenkawa...
Knock it off.
So what are we supposed to do once we get there?
Omoikane's self-awareness... proof that the Nadesico is the Nadesico.
Proof that it wants to be itself.
Proof that it wants to be itself...
Its precious memories. Ones it couldn't forget even if it wanted to.
...Can't forget even if it wants to. Proof that it is itself... huh.
This talk is too hard!
Make it forget, just for a little while.
Make it forget?
Look. That point there. Please cut it.
...It's sad, but branches grow back. Someday, Omoikane will remember.
And the Nadesico won't stop being the Nadesico.
Got it.
Omoikane, forget just a little... and grow up.
Pretend to obey the Federation, and the Nadesico can stay itself...
Everyone, look!
Wh-Whoa!! Wh-Why are they here, of all places!?
Wh-What's going on!? Uribatake!
...So they showed up.
Why are there Jovian mechs in here?
The computer's urge to purge foreign bodies... Omoikane's self-defense.
Huh?
It's the energy of not wanting to forget what's precious.
Omoikane knows the intruders are Akito and the rest of you.
So it's using images of the enemies that impressed you most strongly
to protect its memories.
Using our past combat records, eh? I see, Omoikane...
truly lives up to being the finest work of Nergal Heavy Industries.
Only Nergal's power... I wonder?
Well, sure, those guys left a strong impression, but...
You're the ones who've beaten them, Tenkawa. So...
So you want us to fight!
Please. While Commander Hazuki stalls the Federation work crew,
finish the job.
Isn't it bad for the captain to be in here at a time like that?
Get 'em, Akito! Beat those imaginary mechs!
She doesn't seem to care, so let's go on ahead.
...Enemies that left a strong impression on 'us,' then...
Yeah, I doubt it'll stop at Jovian mechs. Well then...
Oh yeah, I forgot to mention... finish the job within 10 minutes.
We only have 10 minutes!?
Yeah. I'm running a dummy program to hide our debugging, but...
it'll hold 10 minutes, tops.
Let's hurry! If we're found, it's all for nothing!
Tch... looks like we called it.
Hey, hey, isn't that...
Yeah, the Jovians' fake Gekiganger!
Seems it's brought out enemies that left an even stronger impression...
Strong impression, whatever! Doesn't matter!
An imaginary copy of a robot that's already a Gekiganger knockoff...
could never beat our love for Gekiganger!
Yamada is right.
Tenkawa and Yamada... and all of you
should have stronger feelings about the mechs you've faced.
My... our feelings...
That's right! No matter how much it's memorized,
we're the ones who actually fought them!
Tch, like I'm gonna let some copycat
made from memory push me around!
That's right, Akito!
Those are your feelings from fighting for me, so you'll definitely win!
...Seems one person here has misread the situation, though?
No time to point out every little thing. ...Here they come!
More of them! Those... seem different from the enemies so far...
What...! That's the Gundam... Prototype Unit 2...!
Shiro!
That's... the complete Apsaras!
And Hyoma! That's...
Garuda...? Quit screwing around...!
Seems the Gandor and Ra Cailum data was already loaded too...
Even making Shapiro's machine...
Yeah... but that it'd only end up rubbing us the wrong way...
seems that's one thing it didn't see coming...
Omoikane knows it's at a disadvantage,
so it's trying all sorts of images. We must be close.
Very well.
Then we shall teach you that such foolish tactics will not work!
And you shall learn how harsh the world can be.
Coming up with all kinds of nasty tricks, huh. But... watch this.
See if your data can measure our wild side! Let's do this!!
Go, go! Give 'em what for! Huh? ...Ruri, what's wrong?
...Omoikane, of everything so far, what do you think is strongest...?
The Einst...!
I kind of saw this coming, though.
...True. But it's only data, after all.
Omoikane, even these...!?
It's not holding back anymore. ...But we're doing this to save you!
Why can't you understand that!
Sometimes a stubborn fool needs a beating...! Let's go!
I'll see for myself... just how well they've been recreated...!
All right! I've got a hold on it!
Hurry and... prune Omoikane's memories.
The Federation's work is about to start.
The memory part... where is it!?
Hey, Ruri! What exactly is it...
Checking. ...Please hold out a little longer.
Hey, hey, get it together!
...Understood.
But... this is virtual space... so what is this feeling?
...Something's off. I have a bad feeling.
Show!
The red-haired woman! Show! Could it be...!
No! That's nothing but a lump of data...!
Omoikane... going this far... for your memories...
To be yourself... no matter how painful a memory may be,
it's something you can't do without.
But everyone fights on, carrying all of that deep in their hearts.
Deep in their hearts...?
But... the aura of hatred... remembering it...
no, even knowing it, is wrong...! I'll cut it off!
...!! No, look out!
Akira!? What's wrong? ...Ahh!
I see, so what Hoshino was talking about really was...
...!! That giant... Einst!
Everyone, be careful! Like the enemies so far,
it's bound to be stronger than the real one we fought!
Akito! Hang in there! Save the Nadesico!
For Omoikane's sake too...
Yeah... the enemies we've fought...
We really fought them, so we know things data can never record...
(...What makes them terrifying isn't their machines' specs...
It's something more fundamental...!)
Hurry! We're out of time!
We can't lose the Nadesico here!
Uribataaake! Isn't there some secret trick or hidden command!?
Hmmm, I do have an ace up my sleeve... Let's try it.
There was so little real data that the reproduction isn't complete, though...
Quit holding out on us!
We won't be surprised whatever comes out! Hurry it up!
Anything's fine!
All right... if it works, it's a bonus! Installing the program!
No way!?
The Tobikage...! Uribatake! You can create a ninja...!?
Could it be... you are the legendary...
Hey, hey! Princess Romina!
You really didn't get this whole virtual space thing, did you!?
...That's well made.
Truth is, it's not much more than a cardboard cutout.
Only a sword for weapons, and no combining. I don't get how that works.
...Joe! Don't count on it too much, okay!?
Thanks, Uribatake!
All right, it ain't the real thing, but I'm getting fired up! Let's do this!
(Hm...? The details look a little different from the one I made...?)
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
1. Destroy Einst Regisseur.
1. All allies destroyed 2. Victory conditions not met within 10 turns
C-Combining!?
Awesome! Not bad at all!
Uribatake?
(...Just as I thought, the one I made failed to install...!
So... is that the real thing!? How the heck!?)
Self-defense response gone. Memory correction complete...
Phew...
Looks like we made it in time, somehow...
But is this really okay? Going this far...
It'd be bad if the Federation work crew noticed, right?
No proooblem!
As long as we finish before the dummy info gets cracked,
it's set up so we can slip right out!
What? So we didn't need to rush that much?
That's not true.
If the dummy got cracked, they'd know we were up to something.
And if they checked the whole ship, it'd be all over.
Then they'd have checked the virtual room with our real bodies, too.
I see! Uripi, you're the best!
The bessst.
Heh, knock it off.
No, no, you really came through! Uribatake!
And the Tobikage program was amazing too. Not bad at all.
(That's the one thing I can't figure out...)
Quite the computer maintenance job that was.
It felt like they were peeking at my memories too. Wasn't fun...
Having my own obsessions shoved in my face hit a little hard.
Uraki...
What're you talking about!
We got another shot at beating our rivals. Just call it a bonus.
...I guess that's one way to see it. Very positive.
Hyoma's just carefree, that's all.
Hm? Ruri...?
Thank you...
The way you all believe so strongly, Tenkawa... it's wonderful...
Damn right! Our justice and our burning passion for Gekiganger
can't be turned into data!
(Obsession, huh. ...But if mere data gives me trouble, I've far to go.
...Excellen.)
That was... kinda fun.
...Thank you...
Well then!
Now the Nadesico's back to normal and we're all together again. Hooray!
All right, then I'm shutting down the virtual program.
Yeah, let's hurry back.
Old man Hazuki must be having a hard time fooling the inspectors.
No kidding. The Commander's a lousy liar.
Hm... Omoikane...?
...Those unforgettable days...
Yeah... that's right...
